name: getUpdateLocation
description: Before calling this API, first retrieve data using the getEIMAttributeList API. If any required fields are missing in the user's input, populate them using corresponding values from the getLocation API response. When updating fields such as country, province, or district, if the user provides only the name (e.g., "Central" for province), the system should fetch and use the corresponding value (e.g., "000001") for processing.
